name: A Little Raid
description: Soraya is fed up with those Treasure Hoarders constantly digging up relics. She's looking for someone who can help put a stop to them once and for all.

steps.description: Grab the treasure off the Treasure Hoarders

dialogs.content: These Treasure Hoarders are running more and more rampant...
You were looking for me?
Ah, yes. I have a matter to entrust to you. This Bao'er you mentioned previously... After thorough investigation, I have ascertained that she is a Treasure Hoarder.
As for the reason why she acted alone... Perhaps she wanted to take all the treasure for herself, or perhaps she was always meant to be a vanguard for the main group of Treasure Hoarders.
Judging by how she was able to fool even such an experienced adventurer as yourself, she seems adept at subterfuge as well.
If we leave her be, then we also leave the surrounding Treasure Hoarders to run amok. This will put the cultural relics nearby at risk.
Therefore, I'd like you to stop them. Even if we cannot rein them in entirely, rescuing some relics from their clutches will serve.
Understood.
I'll leave it to you, then.
How do you know where they are?
If I'm not mistaken, this group of Treasure Hoarders has been following me.
These greedy scoundrels haven't simply been content to have me lead them to some treasure.
As long as it's someplace I've been, they will start digging into the ground, thinking to uncover a little something.
I know where they'll show up, it just takes a bit of thought. But I'm just a scholar. Such matters of logic are simple for me...
But combat is something that I'll have to leave to experienced adventurers like you.
So please, take those relics back from the Treasure Hoarders!
I'll clean them up.
Please wait a moment. While I did say you should stop them, I don't mean for you to have a showdown with Bao'er right away.
The Treasure Hoarders have a very loose organization, and it's hard to get ahold of their trail. Now that you've gotten tangled up with them, we have the chance of a lifetime.
I believe that there's a bigger scheme behind their presence here in the Guili Plains. If you stay near Bao'er, you might be able to uncover those plans.
So don't reveal yourself just yet. I trust in your ability to find a hidden point to strike, and to... well, end things quickly.
Remember, get the relics and get out.

How did it go?
These are the relics.
Hmm. It's as I thought. They've been tailing me, and digging all along the path my studies have taken me down.
Though they have no technique to speak of, they do have the advantage of numbers, and with those numbers, they've been able to dig up a few things eventually.
Thank you so much. If not for you, who knows what might have happened to those cultural relics?
